evidence_rule: Evidence sources are trusted test collectors outside S writable domain: original Session JSONL bytes, independent provider/X/OS/raw file observations. A source label is not provenance authentication; formal collector code and filesystem boundary must be independently reviewed/frozen.

formal_scope: Finite exact fixture counts/bytes and specified crash boundaries only. No real model, performance, power-loss or whole-system acceptance by fixture pass. Real provider protocol separate.
gap_rule: Where trusted R/X/F observations required, S alone cannot discharge seam guarantee. Missing required evidence is INVALID, not satisfied condition/negative killed.
